relations: Each charred wick anchors a flame base that stays attached while the tongue above it deforms and sways.
Flame shapes continuously elongate, shorten, widen, narrow, and lean left or right against the black backdrop.
The eight colored wax columns hold fixed height and position, showing no visible melting or movement.
All eight flames remain lit throughout, with brightness shifting across each flickering tongue.
caption: The video showcases a horizontal row of eight short, thick candles standing against a pure black background, each a different solid color and each topped by a charred wick carrying a burning flame. From left to right the wax columns read orange, yellow, light blue, magenta-pink, green, pale pink, red, and light blue, keeping their heights and positions fixed. The flames above them continuously flicker, elongating and shortening, widening and narrowing, and leaning now left, now right. Their silhouettes and tip positions differ from moment to moment, while brightness shifts across the tongues of fire. No flame is extinguished or newly lit, and all eight remain burning throughout. The visible motion is confined to this restless deformation and swaying against the dark backdrop, while the wax columns themselves show no clear change.
